name: Rigged Ramen Cart AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star
description: A seemingly innocent ramen cart is rigged to detonate if moved from its current location.
disable: DC 40 Thievery (master) to disable the detonation trigger

generalAbilities.name: Death by Noodle
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The cart is moved, damaged, or physically searched

Effect The cart explodes in a 40-foot radius, dealing 10d6 Fire Damage]{10d6 fire damage and and 10d6 piercing damage} to all creatures within the area (Basic DC 36 Reflex Saving Throw save).

Creatures who fail their save against this effect are also covered in "noodles" of tar and other sticky alchemical substances that make the creature Clumsy 2 until they spend at least an hour scrubbing the noodles off.
